description: This file defines the TypeScript type declarations for the 'Denque' class, a double-ended queue data structure, including its constructors, methods, and associated options interface.

classes.name: Denque
classes.description: A generic class representing a double-ended queue, supporting operations such as add, remove, peek, and convert to array.

methods.name: push
methods.description: Adds an item to the back of the deque.

methods.name: unshift
methods.description: Adds an item to the front of the deque.

methods.name: pop
methods.description: Removes and returns the item at the back of the deque.

methods.name: shift
methods.description: Removes and returns the item at the front of the deque.

methods.name: peekBack
methods.description: Returns the item at the back of the deque without removing it.

methods.name: peekFront
methods.description: Returns the item at the front of the deque without removing it.

methods.name: peekAt
methods.description: Returns the item at the specified index without removing it.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Retrieves the item at the specified index.

methods.name: remove
methods.description: Removes a number of items starting from a specified index.

methods.name: removeOne
methods.description: Removes and returns a single item at the specified index.

methods.name: splice
methods.description: Removes and optionally inserts items at a specified index.

methods.name: isEmpty
methods.description: Checks whether the deque is empty.

methods.name: clear
methods.description: Clears all items from the deque.

methods.name: size
methods.description: Returns the number of items in the deque.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the deque.

methods.name: toArray
methods.description: Converts the deque to an array.
